assets.title: Un superagente. Con alma de QBasic.
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: image 1 of a coherent five-image Spanish social campaign for the real open-source coding agent S42 Agent. Create ONE finished square 1:1 commercial poster, high resolution, with all typography rendered in the image.
Input image 1 is a PRODUCT UI STRUCTURE reference only: its real QBasic-style terminal, DOS-blue workspace, gray menu bars, thin character borders, rectangular windows with [X], cyan selections and permanent bottom prompt. Do not copy its errors, user paths, numbers, old send button or old content.
Art direction: sophisticated retro-computing meets premium developer-tool advertising. Near-black navy background, electric DOS blue, turquoise/cyan accents, warm off-white typography. Bold contemporary grotesk headlines and crisp monospace UI, only two typography families. Generous spacing, deliberate grid, exceptionally readable Spanish, subtle terminal-cell/grid texture and restrained light. No robots, no people, no laptop stock photo, no childish pixel mascot, no generic futuristic holograms.
Layout: small top-left wordmark "S42 AGENT", top-right "01 / 05". Large powerful headline in upper third. A large, very legible, nearly front-facing terminal occupies the middle-lower part, with a little layered depth behind its two classic rectangular auxiliary windows. UI is recognizably a flat TEXT-BASED TUI, not a web dashboard; [X] and box-drawing borders, no rounded app cards. All important artwork within safe margins.
Headline, verbatim:
"Un superagente."
"Con alma de QBasic."
Subheadline, verbatim:
"El poder de la IA, en una terminal que se disfruta."
Terminal header menus, legible but subordinate:
"Archivo  Projects  Models  Promptings  Tools  Vista" and "Ayuda" at far right.
Tabs: "P:mi-proyecto" and "F:index.ts".
Central title: "mi-proyecto".
Minimal chat in terminal:
"Vos: Creá una landing para mi proyecto."
"Agente: Voy a revisar los archivos y construirla."
"list → src/"
"write → index.html"
Use yellow for Vos, cyan for Agente, white body text.
Layer one modest gray window "Tools nativas [X]" listing "read · write · edit · shell".
Layer another modest gray window "Projects [X]" showing "Name: mi-proyecto" and "Folder: ./mi-proyecto".
Keep a bottom fixed area titled "Prompt" visible, with "Enter: enviar · Shift+Enter: nueva línea". Do not show an Enviar button. A visible pixel mouse pointer emphasizes that this TUI supports mouse.
Beneath the terminal, three clean short feature labels, verbatim:
"VENTANAS + MOUSE"   "ATAJOS VIM"   "100% BUN"
Footer: "Open source · MIT" on the left; "github.com/stock42/s42-agent" on the right.
Constraints: spell S42 AGENT correctly. Spanish accents correct. No claims about untested OS behavior, unlimited AI capabilities, benchmark metrics or fabricated certifications. Produce an original commercial composition inspired by the product reference, not merely a screenshot pasted into a frame.

assets.title: Tus proyectos. Sin perder el hilo.
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: image 2 of a five-image Spanish commercial social carousel for S42 Agent. ONE square 1:1 high-resolution finished poster.
Input image 1 is the STYLE REFERENCE: match its top S42 AGENT wordmark, typography, near-black navy dotted background, cyan and DOS-blue palette, thin dividers, premium retro-tech look and footer. Do not copy its headline or feature content. Same campaign, different composition.
Brand and index: "S42 AGENT" at top left and "02 / 05" at top right.
Large headline, verbatim:
"Tus proyectos."
"Sin perder el hilo."
Subheadline, verbatim:
"Proyectos, archivos y contexto. Todo a mano."
Centerpiece: a crisp, large, almost frontal QBasic TEXT-BASED terminal, with a thin square white character border and gray top menus "Archivo  Projects  Models  Promptings  Tools  Vista" and "Ayuda". Tabs must clearly distinguish "P:tienda |", "P:api /" and the selected "F:index.ts". The | and / represent independent activity indicators, not extra words. No web-style sidebars, browser chrome, rounded cards, or macOS traffic lights. The dark-blue main file tab is titled "index.ts" and contains a few clean readable TypeScript lines with cyan, purple, yellow and green syntax colors:
"interface Project {"
"  name: string;"
"  folder: string;"
"}"
"const project = {"
"  name: 'tienda',"
"  folder: './tienda'"
"};"
Its subordinate status says "TypeScript · solo lectura".
One prominent overlapping classic gray character-box window, caption "Explorador de archivos" with [X]. Show a path field "/proyectos", a search field "Buscar: *.ts", and a short file tree:
"[D] tienda/"
"[D] api/"
"[F] index.ts"
"[F] styles.css"
"[F] app.html"
Selected row cyan. Small text "Buscar · Abrir · Adjuntar". No personal real directories or user names. Keep bottom fixed "Prompt" panel visible; no Enviar button. If additional text would be too tiny, use fewer lines.
Below the centerpiece render three clear independent short feature callouts, verbatim:
"PROYECTOS EN PESTAÑAS"
"EXPLORADOR + BÚSQUEDA"
"COLOR PARA HTML · CSS · JS · TS"
Footer matching reference: "Open source · MIT" and "github.com/stock42/s42-agent".
Composition: large headline with plenty of breathing room, highly legible UI screen, grid aligned feature labels, no clutter, polished commercial finish. Text must be correctly spelled with Spanish accents. This is an illustrative UI visualization of verified features, not a literal capture. No benchmark numbers, untested OS claims or invented functions.

assets.title: Tu idioma. Tu estilo.
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: image 3 of a five-image Spanish commercial social campaign for S42 Agent. Create ONE square 1:1 high-resolution finished poster.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE, matching the brand wordmark, headline font, crisp monospace secondary font, navy dotted background, thin cyan dividers, restrained retro-tech premium aesthetic and footer. Do not copy its headline or scene. Keep this clearly part of the same campaign.
Top-left "S42 AGENT"; top-right "03 / 05".
Headline, verbatim, large and spacious:
"Tu idioma."
"Tu estilo."
Subheadline, verbatim:
"Un agente, seis temas y una experiencia simple."
Main composition: six miniature QBasic TEXT-BASED terminal windows, in a carefully aligned 3-column by 2-row grid. Each is large enough to read, with sharp rectangular character borders, classic gray or theme-tinted menu/title bars, a tiny read-only chat and fixed Prompt strip. No rounded web cards, no browser controls, no macOS traffic lights.
Each theme is captioned clearly OUTSIDE its miniature UI with these six exact labels, in reading order:
"QBasic" (DOS-blue workspace, gray bar, cyan highlight, white text)
"Grafito" (charcoal workspace, gray bar, off-white text, muted gray highlights)
"Bosque" (deep forest-green workspace, pale sage bar, mint text)
"Nord" (blue-gray workspace, ice-blue accents, light text)
"Dracula" (dark charcoal-purple workspace, lavender accents, light text)
"Gruvbox" (warm dark brown-gray workspace, amber accents, cream text)
The themes must have visually distinguishable actual background/accent colors, not just different colored title bars on six identical blue panels. All are the SAME layout.
Inside each terminal, show only the monospace labels "Proyecto", "Vos: Hola.", "Agente: Listo.", "Prompt", or their short English counterparts in three of the examples "Project", "You: Hello.", "Agent: Ready.", "Prompt". Use semantic distinct colors for user/agent labels. Keep small UI text sparse and correct.
A clear horizontal language selector below the grid: "Español  ⇄  English".
Below, two compact plain feature labels:
"PROYECTOS: NAME + FOLDER"
"ENTER PARA ENVIAR · SHIFT+ENTER PARA NUEVA LÍNEA"
Footer matching reference: "Open source · MIT" and "github.com/stock42/s42-agent".
Constraints: Spanish accents, names and English spelling correct, deliberate spacing, sophisticated product campaign, no invented translation languages, no implication that model configuration is unnecessary. No benchmark numbers, no robot icons, no people, no unnecessary glow obscuring text.
assets.editPrompt:
Use case: text-localization, precise edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, commercial poster 03 / 05 for S42 AGENT.
Keep the entire image unchanged in composition, resolution, style, headline, logo, colors, six theme panels, labels, language selector, footer, background, and all typography placement.
Change ONLY the menus in the three LOWER terminal examples (Nord, Dracula, Gruvbox) into English. Their current menu line "Archivo  Proyectos  Herramientas  Ayuda" must become exactly "File  Projects  Tools  Help". These examples already have Project, You and Agent in English; localize their menus consistently. Preserve the three upper Spanish terminal menus.
In the bottom keyboard feature icon only, replace the misleading keycap text "esc" with "Enter", adjusting that tiny keycap's width if necessary while preserving all surrounding spacing. The nearby "ENTER PARA ENVIAR · SHIFT+ENTER PARA NUEVA LÍNEA" text remains unchanged.
No other additions or changes. Exact English text, crisp legibility, preserve all Spanish accents elsewhere.

assets.title: Tu modelo. Poder para construir.
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: image 4 of a five-image Spanish commercial social campaign for the real S42 Agent. ONE square 1:1 high-resolution finished poster.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE only: same S42 AGENT wordmark, enormous clean off-white/cyan headline, crisp monospace labels, navy dotted background, subtle cyan grid floor, premium retro-computing design and footer. Use an original feature composition.
Top-left "S42 AGENT"; top-right "04 / 05".
Headline, verbatim:
"Tu modelo."
"Poder para construir."
Subheadline, verbatim:
"Archivos, comandos y conexiones desde un mismo agente."
Central large nearly frontal QBasic TEXT-BASED terminal with DOS-blue background, thin white rectangular character borders, gray menu bar "Archivo  Projects  Models  Promptings  Tools  Vista" and "Ayuda". Project tab "P:mi-proyecto". Sparse chat under central title "mi-proyecto":
"Vos: Desarrollá mi proyecto."
"Agente: Voy a trabajar con archivos y herramientas."
"read → especificaciones.md"
"write → index.html"
Yellow user label, cyan agent label, neutral body.
Inside this terminal overlay a prominent classic gray window with [X], titled "12 tools nativas". Carefully render the twelve tool names, two neat columns of six, all exact:
left column:
"read"
"write"
"edit"
"list"
"find"
"search"
right column:
"fetch"
"shell"
"internal_skill"
"markdown_html"
"websocket"
"scrape"
Readable names, clean square character framing, not rounded web cards. A permanent bottom panel titled "Prompt" stays visible, containing the short example "Construí {{proyecto}}". No Enviar button, no fictitious performance values, no claims of unlimited capabilities.
Under the terminal, four short balanced feature callouts in a 2-by-2 arrangement, exact:
"LLAMA.CPP + DEEPSEEK"
"MCP + SKILLS"
"PROMPTS CON {{VARIABLES}}"
"CLI SIN TUI"
Use small simple line symbols, no third-party brand logos.
Footer matching reference: "Open source · MIT" and "github.com/stock42/s42-agent".
Constraints: maintain strong visual hierarchy and generous spacing, exact Spanish accents and tool names, no invented APIs, no cloud-only message, no privacy guarantee, no model benchmark statistics. The TUI must remain recognizably QBasic text-and-character based.

assets.title: Rápido. Y con números.
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing, precise benchmark infographic.
Asset type: image 5 of a five-image Spanish commercial social campaign for S42 Agent. ONE finished square 1:1 high-resolution poster dedicated EXCLUSIVELY to the recorded benchmark. No product feature panels or UI screenshots.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE only: match its S42 AGENT top-left wordmark, off-white bold headline, cyan accents, near-black navy dotted background, thin cyan dividers and sophisticated terminal-inspired visual identity. Use a cleaner infographic composition with immaculate numeric typography.
Top-left "S42 AGENT"; top-right "05 / 05".
Large headline, exact:
"Rápido."
"Y con números."
Clear subtitle, exact:
"Benchmark registrado · v0.1.0 · Linux x64"
Main data hierarchy: one large DOS-blue rectangular metric panel with thin cyan character-inspired corners, and below it four aligned compact rectangular metric panels in a 2-by-2 grid. These are five separate metrics, not a comparison chart. Keep all values and their correct units large, unambiguous and easily readable. Do not invent additional values, rankings or inference speeds.
Main panel:
"24,43 ms"
"Arranque · p95"
Four panels in reading order, exact numeric strings and labels:
1. "35,95 ms" / "Input · p95"
2. "4,07 ms" / "Delta SSE a frame · p95"
3. "46,64 MiB" / "Memoria RSS en reposo"
4. "42,07 ms" / "Reanudar 1.000 mensajes"
All decimal commas are Spanish formatting of actual measured values. Never mix units or labels. Especially: 46,64 is MiB, not milliseconds; 42,07 is milliseconds for loading 1,000 session messages, not LLM speed. Only first three timing metrics show p95; resumption does not.
Below the panels, readable method information in clearly separated concise lines, EXACT:
"30 arranques · 100 inputs · 20 deltas SSE"
"PTY · caché caliente · sin inferencia LLM"
"Se miden bytes recibidos, no pintura del emulador."
"Core Ultra 9 275HX · Ubuntu 24.04.5 · Bun 1.4.2"
At the footer:
"Fuente: docs/qa/final-validation.md"
"github.com/stock42/s42-agent"
Constraints: the benchmark is a historical recorded measurement for v0.1.0, do not portray it as a new test or the speed of the model. Include every methodological line clearly, not microtext. No icons for platforms, no fictional tokens/sec, no faster-than-competitor claims, no percentages, no awards, no additional claims about memory leaks or zero resource use. Clean spacing and safe margins. The benchmark numbers and labels are the sole visual hero after the headline.
assets.editPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, unit label correction.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the S42 AGENT benchmark poster 05 / 05.
Preserve the entire poster exactly: composition, dimensions, headline, wordmark, every metric value, all labels, all method/source text, fonts, colors, spacing, panels and background.
Make ONLY this tiny text correction in the lower-left memory metric:
The current capitalized unit "MIB" must be "MiB": uppercase M, lowercase i, uppercase B. Render the metric as exactly "46,64 MiB", with a clearly lowercase dotted i and matching original type size. This is the standard binary memory unit.
Do not modify any other number, word or element. All other metrics and the benchmark conditions must remain unchanged and legible.
